# Wix
> Wix is a website builder and business platform for creating, managing, and growing websites, online stores, and web applications.

Wix provides tools for site creation, hosting, ecommerce, bookings, payments, developer extensibility, and business management. Its ecosystem includes end-user help content, developer documentation for Velo and APIs, app development resources, SEO guidance, and product-specific support.

## Main Platform
- [Wix Homepage](https://www.wix.com/): Main entry point for Wix website building, hosting, and business solutions.
- [Website Builder](https://www.wix.com/website-builder): Overview of Wix’s drag-and-drop website creation platform.
- [Templates](https://www.wix.com/website/templates): Browse website templates for businesses, portfolios, stores, and blogs.
- [Features](https://www.wix.com/features): Summary of core Wix platform capabilities and business tools.
- [App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market): Marketplace for adding apps and integrations to Wix sites.
- [Pricing](https://www.wix.com/premium-purchase-plan/dynamo): Plans and pricing for premium Wix subscriptions and upgrades.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://support.wix.com/en/): Central support hub for Wix products, setup, and troubleshooting.
- [Website Design](https://support.wix.com/en/category/website-design): Help articles for designing and customizing Wix sites.
- [Domains](https://support.wix.com/en/category/domains): Support for connecting, transferring, and managing domains.
- [Billing](https://support.wix.com/en/category/billing): Articles about payments, invoices, subscriptions, and billing issues.
- [SEO](https://support.wix.com/en/category/seo): Support content for search optimization on Wix sites.
- [Accessibility](https://support.wix.com/en/category/accessibility): Guidance for improving accessibility on Wix websites.

## Business Solutions
- [Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/category/wix-stores): Help for ecommerce setup, products, orders, and store management.
- [Wix Bookings](https://support.wix.com/en/category/wix-bookings): Support for scheduling, services, staff, and appointments.
- [Wix Restaurants](https://support.wix.com/en/category/wix-restaurants): Documentation for restaurant menus, ordering, and reservations.
- [Wix Events](https://support.wix.com/en/category/wix-events): Help for event creation, tickets, registration, and attendee management.
- [Wix Blog](https://support.wix.com/en/category/wix-blog): Support for creating and managing blogs on Wix.
- [Wix Multilingual](https://support.wix.com/en/category/wix-multilingual): Guidance for translating and managing multilingual sites.

## Developer Platform
- [Wix Developers](https://dev.wix.com/): Main portal for Wix developer tools, APIs, and extensibility.
- [Velo by Wix](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites): Documentation for developing custom functionality on Wix sites.
- [Wix Headless](https://dev.wix.com/docs/go-headless): Resources for building headless experiences with Wix services.
- [CLI](https://dev.wix.com/docs/sdk/articles/workspace-tools/wix-cli): Documentation for the Wix CLI and local development workflows.
- [Blocks](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/frameworks/wix-blocks/about-wix-blocks): Introduction to Wix Blocks for reusable app interfaces.
- [Studio for Developers](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/workspace-tools/developer-mode/about-dev-mode): Developer mode and advanced tooling for Wix site development.

## API Reference
- [API Reference Home](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference): Entry point for Wix API documentation and service references.
- [REST APIs](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest): Reference for Wix REST APIs across platform services.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://dev.wix.com/docs/sdk): SDK documentation for interacting with Wix services programmatically.
- [Web Modules](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-velo/backend-code/web-modules/about-web-modules): Backend web modules for exposing server-side functions.
- [HTTP Functions](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-velo/integrations/exposing-services/about-http-functions): Create custom HTTP endpoints from Wix backend code.
- [Events and Service Plugins](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/frameworks/self-hosting/supported-extensions/service-plugins/about-service-plugins): Extend Wix services with custom integrations and event-driven behavior.

## Guides and Tutorials
- [Develop Websites Guides](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites): Guides for building advanced functionality on Wix websites.
- [Build Apps Guides](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps): Documentation for creating apps for Wix users and sites.
- [Get Started with Velo](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/getting-started/about-velo-by-wix): Introductory guide to Velo development on Wix.
- [Backend Code](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-velo/backend-code): Learn backend coding patterns and server-side capabilities.
- [Frontend Code](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-velo/frontend-code): Learn client-side coding patterns for Wix sites.
- [Databases and Collections](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/databases/wix-data/about-your-site-database): Guide to managing site data with Wix collections.

## App Development
- [Build Apps Overview](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps): Overview of Wix app development architecture and workflows.
- [Get Started Building an App](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/get-started): Introductory path for creating a Wix app.
- [App Dashboard](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/manage-your-app/app-dashboard/about-the-app-dashboard): Manage app settings, releases, and configuration.
- [OAuth](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/access/authentication/about-oauth): Authentication and authorization for Wix app integrations.
- [Self-Hosted Apps](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/frameworks/self-hosting): Build and deploy self-hosted Wix apps.
- [Submit Your App](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/launch-your-app/submit-your-app): Process for reviewing and publishing apps to Wix users.

## SEO and Marketing
- [Wix SEO Learning Hub](https://www.wix.com/seo/learn): Educational content for SEO strategy and implementation.
- [SEO Setup Checklist](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-seo-setup-checklist): Step-by-step checklist for optimizing a Wix site for search.

- [Meta Tags](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-changing-your-pages-title-tag-and-meta-description): Manage page title tags and meta descriptions in Wix.
- [Structured Data](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-custom-structured-data-markup-to-your-sites-pages): Add custom structured data markup to Wix pages.
- [Email Marketing](https://support.wix.com/en/category/wix-email-marketing): Support for campaigns, contacts, and email marketing tools.

- [Studio Academy](https://www.wix.com/studio/academy): Training resources for professionals using Wix Studio.

- [Studio Community](https://www.wix.com/studio/community): Community resources and collaboration for Wix Studio users.
